Thanks — appreciate the early heads-up. Ops has a standing quarterly maintenance window on Sept 23 that just popped up, so we can’t do the morning slot. Two asks from our side:

1) Can we move to Thu, Sept 24 in the afternoon ET? Prefer 2:00–4:30 PM ET or 4:00–6:30 PM ET (we’d take the later slot if available).
2) Can the session be split into a 90-minute console walkthrough (key admin flows + access) and a focused 60–90 minute API enablement (keys, sandbox, sample integrations)? Ops would like a shorter console block up front so they can step out if needed.

We’ll include the ops distribution list on the invite (ops-team@finlogic.com). Also — can you share a prep checklist/runbook and any role/access instructions so we can provision accounts in advance?
